name_en: Saba no bozushi — pressed rod-shaped sushi of vinegar-cured mackerel
summary_ja: 酢締めした塩サバを酢飯で巻き、棒状に成形した押し寿司。鯖街道を経て届いたサバを使う湖北・湖西の料理のひとつで、大津や長浜の曳山祭りに欠かせないご馳走として供されてきたと伝わる。
summary_en: Salt-cured, vinegar-set mackerel is rolled around vinegared rice and pressed into a log-shaped sushi. Made with mackerel carried along the old Saba Kaido route, it has long been a festival treat at the Otsu and Nagahama float parades.
source_title: 鯖の棒ずし 滋賀県

name_en: Hitokawa zushi — a box sushi pressed in four or five colorful layers
summary_ja: 酢飯と干ししいたけ、人参、錦糸卵などの具材を寿司桶に何段も重ねて押し固める箱寿司。一段ずつ取り分けて食べることから「ひとかわすし」と呼ばれ、一度に大人数分をつくれることから人寄せの席に伝わる。
summary_en: Vinegared rice and colorful toppings such as dried shiitake, carrot, and shredded egg are layered four or five times in a wooden mold and pressed. Served by lifting off one layer at a time, the sushi can feed twenty to forty people at once, making it a fixture at large gatherings.
source_title: ひとかわすし 滋賀県
